title: Sensor node: design review summary
subtitle: Synthetic example generated from example-system/ by /exec-deck
footer: Synthetic reference system. No real product or program.

stats.label: requirements, all with tests or budgets

slides.title: Requirements highlights
bullets: 100 Hz IMU sampling, 1 Hz temperature, one 16-byte packet per second (SN-REQ-001 to 005)
CRC-16 on every packet; corrupted packets are rejected on the host (SN-REQ-006)
Fault detection: out-of-range temperature and 5 missed IMU samples (SN-REQ-007, 008)
Host-buildable firmware with -Wall -Wextra -Werror, no heap after init (SN-REQ-022, 023)

slides.title: Power budget: where the current goes
slides.note: Total 2.97 mA vs 2.70 mA limit. Source: docs/POWER-BUDGET.md

slides.title: Decision: implement sleep mode now
left: Closes SN-BUG-003 and SN-HAZ-004 in one change
Battery life 28 days to about 40 days
right: Needs a wake-timer driver and new tests
Sleep entry adds 0.1 ms to the loop

slides.title: Security and quality posture
bullets: Packet parser rejects bad length, sync, and CRC before any field is used
Reserved flag bits rejected at build time (SN-BUG-002 closed)
Same tests run against C firmware and the Python twin
No dynamic allocation after init; strict compiler warnings are errors

slides.title: Asks for leadership
bullets: Approve sleep-mode work as the next sprint's priority
Decide whether CAN (SN-CAP-002) stays on the roadmap; it needs a 5 V rail
Accept SN-HAZ-005 (timing overrun) at risk level 4

slides.text: Every number on these slides is recomputed from the repository, not typed in.
